body: From the DM-184 review (orchestrator, this run): experiments are counted by `retroIsEmpty` (plan/retro.ts:114) but not rendered in retroView.ts / RetroSections.tsx, so an experiments-only retro passes the gate and shows nothing to the approver; render them. Wire `recordExperimentEvent`/`getExperiment` (no caller yet) where the retro flow needs them.
